diagnosis: The GET handler decodes uidb64 and returns sensitive user account details (username, email, organization, MFA configuration status) before verifying that the token in the URL is valid. An unauthenticated attacker can enumerate base64 user IDs to harvest the directory of registered users and their organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/auth/password-reset-confirm/MTAwNQ/invalid-token-here/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.enterprise-workspace.com
Accept: application/json
